faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.q1: What is the difference between KNX and Zigbee?
faq.a1: KNX is a wired open standard planned during construction, ideal for villas and large projects. Zigbee is wireless and added to existing homes with minimal wiring.
faq.q2: Can an existing home become a smart home?
faq.a2: Yes — usually with Zigbee, without breaking walls or new wiring in most cases.
faq.q3: Does the service include installation and programming?
faq.a3: Yes — we provide design, installation, programming and scene setup per project.
faq.a4: It depends on the product and system, and is shown on each product page.

system.knx_lead: Professional automation for advanced projects. Designed with the plan, built into the walls, working for years unnoticed.
system.knx_what_title: One line runs through the house, and every device speaks on it.
system.knx_what_text: In KNX, switches, dimmers, curtains and climate share one cable. Every device knows its role, and the home can be reprogrammed without rewiring.
system.knx_f1_d: Not tied to one manufacturer. Devices from different brands work together.
system.knx_f2_d: Independent of Wi-Fi, and keeps working without internet.
system.knx_f3_d: Starts with lighting and grows with the home: curtains, climate, scenes, security.
system.zigbee_lead: A wireless smart home added to your existing home — no breaking walls, no new wiring.
system.zigbee_what_title: A wireless mesh where every device strengthens the next.
system.zigbee_what_text: Zigbee devices connect to a hub and form a mesh — the more devices, the stronger the network.
system.zigbee_f1_d: Replaces existing switches in most cases.
system.zigbee_f2_d: A whole home in days, not weeks.
system.zigbee_f3_d: Start with one room and add the rest later.
system.control4_lead: A central controller bringing audio, video, lighting and security into one interface.
system.control4_what_title: One interface for everything at home.
system.control4_what_text: Control4 connects different systems at home and gives you one control experience — from the wall, the remote or your phone.
system.control4_f1_d: Works with thousands of devices and brands.
system.control4_f3_d: The same interface in every room and on every device.
system.p1_d: We understand how you live and review the plan and stage.
system.p2_d: Devices, circuits and scenes laid out on the plan.
system.p3_d: A detailed quote with devices, execution and timeline.
system.p4_d: Bus wiring, device installation and scene programming.
system.wiring_text: One KNX cable runs alongside the power lines and links every device. It is planned at design or shell stage, then the home is programmed without rewiring.
system.w1_d: A green twin-pair KNX cable links every device.
system.w2_d: One back box per switch or panel, per plan.
system.w3_d: Controllers and actuators in one tidy board.
